program:
app "Electricity" bolt plum
table bill appliance text, amount money
let total = sum(bill.amount)
draw width 220
  each bill sort at as b
    arc 50, 50, 25, 360 * sum(bill, if(it.at < b.at, it.amount, 0)) / total, 360 * (sum(bill, if(it.at < b.at, it.amount, 0)) + b.amount) / total stroke if(index % 5 = 0, accent, if(index % 5 = 1, good, if(index % 5 = 2, warn, if(index % 5 = 3, bad, muted)))) thick 50
"Total bill" total big
each bill sort at as b
  row
    b.appliance grow
    round(b.amount * 100 / total) "%" bold
form bill, "Add appliance"
describe:
Electricity, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- bill: appliance: text; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- total is the total amount of bill.
Shows:
- a drawing made of arcs.
- text: "Total bill", total.
- for each bill sorted by at:
  - text: the appliance of the bill.
  - text: the amount of the bill times 100 divided by total rounded, "%".
- a form to add a bill.
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: start with the numbers or units

app "Percent change" calc ink
state old num = 100
state nw num = 120
field old "Old value"
field nw "New value"
let ch = (nw - old) / max(abs(old), 0.0001) * 100
round(ch * 10) / 10 "%" big color if(ch >= 0, good, bad)
if(ch >= 0, "Increase of", "Decrease of") abs(nw - old) faint
describe:
Percent change, in the ink colours.
Works out:
- ch is the result of nw minus old divided by the larger of old without its sign and 0.0001 times 100.
Remembers while you use it: old, starting at 100; nw, starting at 120.
Shows:
- a box to fill in old, labelled "Old value".
- a box to fill in nw, labelled "New value".
- text: ch times 10 rounded divided by 10, "%".
- text: "Increase of" when ch is at least 0, otherwise "Decrease of", nw minus old without its sign.

program:
app "Match Scores" ball mint
table ball runs num 0..6 = 0, wide bool, out bool
setting overs num = 20
let legal = count(ball today where wide = no)
let runs = sum(ball.runs today) + count(ball today where wide = yes)
let wkts = count(ball today where out = yes)
runs "/" wkts big
"Overs" floor(legal / 6) + legal % 6 / 10 "of" overs faint
row gap 1
  each [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
    button it tap add ball runs = it
row gap 1
  button "Wide" tap add ball wide = yes
  button "Out" fill bad tap add ball out = yes
  button "Undo" tap remove last(ball today)
describe:
Match Scores, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- ball: runs: number, 0 to 6, starts at 0; wide: yes or no; out: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: overs: number, starts at 20.
Works out:
- legal is how many ball entries today where wide is no.
- runs is the total runs of ball today plus how many ball entries today where wide is yes.
- wkts is how many ball entries today where out is yes.
Shows:
- text: runs, "/", wkts.
- text: "Overs", legal divided by 6 rounded down plus legal leaves over when divided by 6 divided by 10, "of", overs.
- for 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6:
  - a button the value; a tap adds a ball with runs set to the value.
- a button "Wide"; a tap adds a ball with wide set to yes.
- a button "Out"; a tap adds a ball with out set to yes.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest ball entries today, with undo.
